import re
from collections import Counter

_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z']+")


def top_words(text, k):
    """Return the k most common words in ``text`` as (word, count) tuples.

    Words are case-insensitive maximal runs of ASCII letters and apostrophes,
    so "don't" is a single word and "well-known" counts as two. Results are
    sorted by count descending, then alphabetically.
    """
    counts = Counter(_WORD_RE.findall(text.lower()))
    ordered = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    return ordered[:k]
